verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-access and IT-management platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The Web API is only a developer building block, and Tia is an in-product AI agent rather than an MCP endpoint, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
